# Ray Data expressions and aggregations

This page maps 179 Ray Data names onto their Batcher spellings, grouped by the class or module they live on. Each row reads in both directions. {doc}`index` explains the statuses and the waves.

To rewrite Ray Data code onto these spellings, run the codemod:

```bash
python -m batcher.migrate --from ray_data --to batcher <paths>
```

Replace `<paths>` with the files or directories to rewrite. This direction isn't implemented yet, so the command refuses it with a `ConfigError`. The implemented directions are `--from batcher --to batcher`. Until yours lands, port by hand with the tables on these pages.
